decisions.thought: Dragonite with Lum Berry and Multiscale effectively checks opponent's sun core (Torkoal and Venusaur). Scarf Gholdengo and Mimikyu provide essential speed control, priority, and coverage against the rest of their team.

Torkoal sets sun with Drought for Venusaur's Chlorophyll and full-power Eruption, giving a strong lead-and-sweep core. Kingambit's Choice Scarf gives much-needed speed control against faster threats like Garchomp and Volcarona in the back.
